sections.title: Unit 21, spoken in full sentences
sections.content: Unit 21 taught the pieces of a work day one at a time: your job, your schedule, your colleagues, your tasks. Combine them and you get a real description of what a workday feels like, not just a list of nouns.

items.spanish: Hétköznap reggel nyolckor kezdődik a munkaidőm, és ötkor végződik.
items.english: On weekdays my working hours start at eight in the morning, and end at five.

items.spanish: A munkatársaimmal gyakran van megbeszélésünk, és jelentéseket írunk.
items.english: I often have meetings with my colleagues, and we write reports.

items.spanish: Néha túlórázom, ha sok a feladat, de ez elég fárasztó.
items.english: Sometimes I work overtime if there's a lot of work, but it's quite tiring.

sections.content: hétköznap works as both a noun ("a weekday") and, without any suffix, an adverb ("on weekdays") — Hétköznap dolgozom needs no extra ending, unlike hétfőn or szombaton.
